title: The notice shows above the tabs with its exact text and cannot be closed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the date on your computer is before the end date of the "New" pill (07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships Technician Toggle).
  • Start on the Settings page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The staff list opens.
  • A notice sits below the page toolbar and above the Active and Deactivated tabs.
  • The notice reads "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."
  • The notice has no close button or other control to close it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • S4-R4: “A notice shows on the staff list, below the page toolbar and above the Active and Deactivated tabs, including when the list fails to load (the existing "Something went wrong loading the staff list. Please try again." line then sits between the toolbar and the notice), with this text: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."”
  • S4-R5: “The notice cannot be closed. It disappears for everyone at the same moment as the "New" pill (S1-R2), including in a page that is already open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Staff list opened before the end date (S4-R4) | "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable." | Info notice at the top of the staff list, cannot be closed, disappears for everyone at the end date”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Changing a staff member's Technician toggle, and seeing the staff list with its Technician column and notice, are governed by 'Settings → App Settings', the existing permission for Staff.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "1 Staff list", pictures "Notice and Technician column" (This build) and "Staff list" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p1-02-after-notice-and-technician-column.png
  • tt-p1-01-before-staff-list.png

The design's own words:

  • “Notice, verbatim: "New: Decide who appears on Board View, Tech View and the technician dropdowns. Turn Technician on or off for each person in their staff settings, next to Sales Representative. To start, it is on for everyone who worked on a work order in the last 90 days, is on open work, or is billable."”
  • “No close button: it disappears for everyone on the "New" pill's end date.”
  • “Technician column, read-only and sortable, just left of Billable: Yes when the person's Technician toggle is on and their Time Clock is on, otherwise No. A deactivated person always shows No. It changes only through the staff window (page 2).”
  • “"New" pill at the top right of the Technician header. It goes away at 07:00 UTC on the seventh day after the release that ships this; the exact date is set when the release is scheduled.”
  • “Billable is the last column. There is no Technician column and no notice.”
